response: Shree Devi Institute of Technology (SDIT) is an engineering college in Kenjar, Mangalore, established in 2006. It's affiliated to VTU and recognized by AICTE. SDIT offers B.E, M.Tech, MBA, MCA, and PhD programs with modern labs, experienced faculty, and strong industry partnerships for placements. Want details on any specific program?

response: SDIT offers B.E in CSE, CSE (AI & ML), ISE, AI & Data Science, ECE, Mechanical, Civil, and Aeronautical Engineering. Postgraduate programs: M.Tech (Construction Technology), MBA, and MCA. A PhD research centre is also available. CET Code: E146. Would you like eligibility details for any of these?
